about: The three ranks of 01-SHARED-INTERFACE.md section 3. Each entry has the shape of the Limits type. Values are PROPOSED and fixed at deploy; no vote can change them.
limit_base: The smaller of brave_at_open and the BRAVE pool now (get_pot().brave.total). A limit in dollars is limit_base x bps / 10000, rounded down. The rulebook text always uses brave_at_open.
